title: Erlang parallel job runner
context: Runs jobs in parallel and returns their results in the same order as Jobs. A job that crashes must give {error, Reason} in its place instead of stalling the others. After a timeout no workers may keep running.
code: Pids = [spawn(?MODULE, worker, [Parent, Job, make_ref()]) || Job <- Jobs],

expected.why: plain spawn without a link or monitor: a crashing job never reports, so the caller waits for the whole timeout instead of getting {error, Reason}
results are collected in completion order, not in the order of Jobs
the reference is ignored, so late messages from an earlier timed-out call are taken as results of this one
workers are not killed on timeout and keep running
